meta.title: France created 1.05 million businesses in 2023
meta.angle: Test deck: every block type a direction must style (line chart, donut, visual, logo row), on official INSEE data.

captions.linkedin: France created 1,051,500 businesses in 2023, almost twice the 2015 figure (INSEE). Most of the growth comes from sole traders under the micro-entrepreneur scheme: companies (sociétés) were 269,900, about one creation in four.
captions.first_comment: Source: INSEE Première no. 1984, business creations in 2023: https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/7759412
captions.instagram: France created 1,051,500 businesses in 2023 (INSEE). About one in four was a company.

blocks.sub: One in four was a company. The rest were mostly sole traders under the micro-entrepreneur scheme.
